cases.question: Tell me about Pdfroo
cases.judge_reason: All claims match the expected facts and known public details about Pdfroo.
cases.answer:
**Pdfroo** is Ayush's fully client-side PDF editor — open a PDF, annotate, sign, rearrange/merge pages, compress, find & replace, and download a real flattened PDF. Nothing ever leaves the browser; all parsing, rendering, and writing happen locally via **pdf.js + pdf-lib**, and it works offline once loaded.

**Highlights**
- Runs on phones, tablets, desktops (mouse, pen, touch)
- No build step, no backend, no install — just open `index.html` or the live demo
- Drag-to-reorder pages (SortableJS), rotate, duplicate, delete, insert blank, merge multiple PDFs
- Light/dark theme, responsive sidebar/drawer/sheet layouts
- Privacy-first: "Your PDF never left your device" toast after first successful download

**Stack:** JavaScript, CSS, HTML (pdf.js, pdf-lib, SortableJS)  
**Live:** https://ayush4u.github.io/pdfroo/  
**Repo:** https://github.com/ayush4u/pdfroo (MIT)
